entries.title: A link finds this computer every way it can
entries.body: Settings → Devices now shows how other devices find this computer: on this network and on your private network, with no address to choose. Over the internet stays off. Copy a link or Copy a command carries every address at once, and the other computer keeps the first one that answers. The other computer needs this version to use a new link.

picture.alt: Settings, Devices, with On this network and On your private network ready, Over the internet off, and Copy a link and Copy a command under them
